basic_details.job_title: Delhi University Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 8 Trained Graduate Teacher, Assistant Teacher Posts
basic_details.short_information: Delhi University has invited applications for 8 posts in 2 roles under Advt No. R&P/324/2026. The posts include Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT), Assistant Teacher (Primary). Applications are accepted online until 18 November 2026.

age_limit.age_details: Maximum 35 years (as on closing date of advertisement)

qualification.education_qualification: Bachelor's Degree or Master's Degree with B.Ed / 4-year integrated B.Ed-M.Ed / B.El.Ed / Diploma in Elementary Education / Special Education, and CTET.

vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: A Bachelor's Degree in the concerned subject with at least 50% marks (studied for at least 2 years) OR Master's Degree with at least 50% marks in Bachelor's or Master's degree, and B.Ed. or 3-year integrated B.Ed.-M.Ed.; OR 4-year integrated programme/course/degree of B.El.Ed. / B.Sc.B.Ed. / B.A.B.Ed. / B.Com.B.Ed. from NCTE-recognized Institution.; Pass in Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET) conducted by CBSE is mandatory. Age limit: Maximum 35 years. Pay: Pay Level - 07. Qualification required: Senior Secondary with at least 50% marks and 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education OR 4-year Bachelor of Elementary Education (B.El.Ed.) OR 2-year Diploma in Education (Special Education) OR Graduation and B.Ed.; Pass in the Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET) cond

salary_details.pay_scale: Pay Level - 06 and Pay Level - 07 as per VII CPC

pattern_table.Subject: General Awareness, General Intelligence & Reasoning ability, Arithmetical & Numerical Ability, Pedagogy Teaching Methodology and Aptitude, Test of English/Hindi Language & Comprehension
Teaching Aptitude and Knowledge of the subject
Skills pertaining to teaching aptitude/methodology of the concerned subject

exam_pattern.details: Negative marking of 0.5 mark for each wrong answer in Preliminary Test. Preliminary Test is only for shortlisting and has no weightage in final assessment. Bilingual question paper (English and Hindi).

how_to_apply: Visit the University website www.du.ac.in and click 'Work with DU' under the Head 'Advertisement - Departments'.
Fill out the online application form in the prescribed format.
Submit the application before the last date.
important_instructions: Any addendum/corrigendum shall be posted on the website only. For technical issues, email to [email protected]

content_sections.text: Age relaxation for all posts: SC/ST/OBC/PwBD/Ex-servicemen As per Central Government rules, Regular Service Up to 5 years relaxation for regular service in Govt/Autonomous bodies/Universities, Contract/Ad-hoc Employees One-time age relaxation for persons working on contract/daily wages/ad-hoc basis in University/Colleges with at least one year of service.

content_sections.text: Other conditions: Candidates must possess prescribed qualifications and experience as on closing date.

rows.qualification: A Bachelor's Degree in the concerned subject with at least 50% marks (studied for at least 2 years) OR Master's Degree with at least 50% marks in Bachelor's or Master's degree, and B.Ed. or 3-year integrated B.Ed.-M.Ed.; OR 4-year integrated programme/course/degree of B.El.Ed. / B.Sc.B.Ed. / B.A.B.Ed. / B.Com.B.Ed. from NCTE-recognized Institution.; Pass in Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET) conducted by CBSE is mandatory.

Senior Secondary with at least 50% marks and 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education OR 4-year Bachelor of Elementary Education (B.El.Ed.) OR 2-year Diploma in Education (Special Education) OR Graduation and B.Ed.; Pass in the Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET) conducted by CBSE.; Must have passed Hindi or English as a subject at the Secondary level.

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: A Bachelor's Degree in the concerned subject with at least 50% marks (studied for at least 2 years) OR Master's Degree with at least 50% marks in Bachelor's or Master's degree, and B.Ed. or 3-year integrated B.Ed.-M.Ed.; OR 4-year integrated programme/course/degree of B.El.Ed. / B.Sc.B.Ed. / B.A.B.Ed. / B.Com.B.Ed. from NCTE-recognized Institution.; Pass in Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET) conducted by CBSE is mandatory. Age limit: Maximum 35 years. Pay: Pay Level - 07. Qualification required: Senior Secondary with at least 50% marks and 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education OR 4-year Bachelor of Elementary Education (B.El.Ed.) OR 2-year Diploma in Education (Special Education) OR Graduation and B.Ed.; Pass in the Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET) conducted by CBSE.; Must have passed Hindi or English as a subject at the Secondary level. Age limit: Maximum 35 years. Pay: Pay Level - 06.

content_sections.heading: How Will Delhi University Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Stage 1: Shortlisting of applicants on the basis of a Preliminary Test (Multiple Choice Question - MCQ based). Stage 2: Examination (Main) (Descriptive). Skill Test (Qualifying in nature). Preliminary Test: 100 questions, 200 marks, Duration 2 hours, MCQ based. Examination (Main): Descriptive questions on Teaching Aptitude and Knowledge of the subject, 200 marks, Duration 2 hours. Skill Test: 100 marks, qualifying in nature.

content_sections.heading: Delhi University Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Negative marking of 0.5 mark for each wrong answer in Preliminary Test. Preliminary Test is only for shortlisting and has no weightage in final assessment. Bilingual question paper (English and Hindi).

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Delhi University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Delhi University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 vacancies: 6 Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT), 2 Assistant Teacher (Primary).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Delhi University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: General/Unreserved: Rs. 1,000. OBC (NCL), EWS, Female: Rs. 800. SC, ST, PwBD: Rs. 600.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years (as on closing date of advertisement). Relaxation: SC/ST/OBC/PwBD/Ex-servicemen As per Central Government rules, Regular Service Up to 5 years relaxation for regular service in Govt/Autonomous bodies/Universities, Contract/Ad-hoc Employees One-time age relaxation for persons working on contract/daily wages/ad-hoc basis in University/Colleges with at least one year of service.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Pay Level - 07 for Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT), Pay Level - 06 for Assistant Teacher (Primary).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Bachelor's Degree or Master's Degree with B.Ed / 4-year integrated B.Ed-M.Ed / B.El.Ed / Diploma in Elementary Education / Special Education, and CTET. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must possess prescribed qualifications and experience as on closing date.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Stage 1: Shortlisting of applicants on the basis of a Preliminary Test (Multiple Choice Question - MCQ based). Stage 2: Examination (Main) (Descriptive). Skill Test (Qualifying in nature). Preliminary Test: 100 questions, 200 marks, Duration 2 hours, MCQ based.

faq.question: Q10. Is there negative marking in the Delhi University exam?
faq.answer: Negative marking of 0.5 mark for each wrong answer in Preliminary Test.
